name: opentwitter-mcp
description: Twitter/X and meme evidence data via the 6551 API. Supports user profiles, tweet search, user tweets, follower events, deleted tweets, KOL followers, meme token evidence, and meme activity.

en.tagline: Twitter/X and meme token data from the 6551 API
en.summary: This skill queries Twitter/X data and meme token evidence through the 6551 platform REST API. It covers user profiles, tweet search, user tweets, follower events, deleted tweets, KOL followers, and meme token activity. It also includes a WebSocket feed for real-time events from accounts on your watch list.
problem: The skill gives you one base URL, https://ai.6551.io, and one token, OPENNEWS_TOKEN. Each data type is a POST endpoint that takes JSON parameters, so you can run requests from a shell with curl or call them from an agent.

Use it to check a user's recent tweets, see who followed or unfollowed an account, find deleted tweets, or pull thesis and callout posts and buy or sell statements for a meme token. For live results, the WebSocket feed pushes events from monitored accounts.
fit: Reviewing a crypto KOL's recent tweets or replies
Tracking new followers or unfollowers of an account
Reviewing meme token callouts and buy or sell statements
Receiving real-time Twitter events over WebSocket
unfit: Data sources outside Twitter/X and the meme feeds listed here
Use without a 6551 token, since every endpoint requires one
steps: Get a token at http://app.newsliquid.com/mcp and set it as OPENNEWS_TOKEN.
Pick an endpoint under https://ai.6551.io/open/, such as twitter_user_tweets or twitter_search.
Send a POST request with a JSON body and the header Authorization: Bearer $OPENNEWS_TOKEN.
Narrow results with filters such as minLikes, sinceDate, or product; tweet requests accept maxResults up to 100.
For meme tokens, call token-evidence for thesis and callout posts, or activity for later statements and trades.
For live events, add accounts with twitter_watch_add, then connect to the WebSocket endpoint and send twitter.subscribe.

zh.tagline: 6551 API 的推特与 Meme 代币数据查询
zh.summary: 该技能通过 6551 平台 REST API 查询推特/X 数据和 Meme 代币证据。覆盖用户资料、推文搜索、用户推文、关注者变动、已删除推文、KOL 关注者和 Meme 代币活动。它还提供 WebSocket 通道，实时推送监控账号的事件。
problem: 该技能只提供一个基础地址 https://ai.6551.io 和一个令牌 OPENNEWS_TOKEN。每类数据都是一个接收 JSON 参数的 POST 接口，可以用 curl 在命令行中调用，也可以由智能体调用。
可以用它查看某用户的近期推文，查看谁关注或取消关注了某账号，找出已删除的推文，或获取某个 Meme 代币的观点帖、喊单帖以及买卖记录。需要实时结果时，WebSocket 通道会推送被监控账号的事件。
fit: 查看加密 KOL 的近期推文或回复
跟踪某账号的新增关注者或取消关注者
查看 Meme 代币的喊单内容和买卖记录
通过 WebSocket 接收推特实时事件
unfit: 列出的推特/X 和 Meme 数据之外的数据来源
没有 6551 令牌的情况，因为所有接口都需要令牌
steps: 在 http://app.newsliquid.com/mcp 获取令牌，并将其设为 OPENNEWS_TOKEN。
从 https://ai.6551.io/open/ 下选择接口，例如 twitter_user_tweets 或 twitter_search。
发送 POST 请求，请求体为 JSON，并带上请求头 Authorization: Bearer $OPENNEWS_TOKEN。
用 minLikes、sinceDate 或 product 等过滤参数缩小结果范围；推文请求的 maxResults 最大为 100。
查询 Meme 代币时，用 token-evidence 获取观点帖和喊单帖，用 activity 获取后续表态和交易记录。
需要实时事件时，用 twitter_watch_add 添加账号，然后连接 WebSocket 端点并发送 twitter.subscribe。
